title: 12,000 accounts suspended and counting..
body:
Avoid this bank at all costs. 

They announced the immediate suspension of over 12,000 accounts of business customers over an SMS stating that KYC documents were ‘out of date’. Accidentally they also suspended thousands of accounts, including ours, where documents were in fact all up to date. 4 days later and all accounts still suspended. 

So we can’t pay our salaries. Staff can’t pay rent and sending pics of landlords throwing their belongings out of their rooms. PDC cheques bouncing resulting in 95 (to date) forced account closures by the Central Bank since they suspended. Suppliers not delivering. Business can’t sell. More cheques bounce. Cargo stuck at ports. Customers flying in from all over the world to try and get their (fully up to date) accounts reopened. FAB staff calling in sick as they can’t handle the backlash. 

FAB: clearly should stand for Fail At Banking
author: DoubleCount

reply.body: Dear customer, we are truly sorry for the inconvenience. We are working to ensure that this never occurs again and that our customers always receive the highest levels of service. Please email atyourservice@bankfab.com with your details and we'll work with our team to see how we can fix this.
